label: GO: confident a1 choice after a run of rewards, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass), and almost only when the agent strongly picks a1: 98% of mass has model_act a1, 75% has choice logit > 8.07. It needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (99% of mass has prev_reward=1), and it is stronger after several rewards in a row, mostly repeated a1 choices that landed on S1. Requiring the trial before that to also not be unrewarded raises dev F1 from 0.77 to 0.80. It also depends strongly on time in the episode: it never fires before ep_trial 50, and its rate climbs steadily from trials 50 to 99. That points to a slow drift in the hidden state, not a task variable; the ep_trial >= 60 cut is an approximation of that drift. Within a window, magnitude grows over consecutive rewarded a1 trials (e.g. 0.29 -> 0.70 -> 0.95 -> 1.0). It drops to about 0.4 after an unrewarded trial, and it is silent at D1 and D2, on a2 choices, and when value is high (it fires at low value, below about 7.5). All predicate variables can be seen at GO (choice is the logit the agent itself computes).
